result.brief: 提出 PixelBench 基准与像素重建微调（PRT），让 LLM 直接用词表生成像素图并统一像素理解与生成，无需图像 tokenizer 或解码器。
result.reason: Benchmarks LLM direct pixel-level image generation without learned tokenizer/decoder, plus pixel reconstruction tuning as auxiliary visual supervision; touches unified understanding-generation and visual representation.
